Subject: Discovery — FinPath: Next steps & technical deep dive

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to hear more about FinPath's ingestion pipeline and how you're thinking about customer-facing latency targets. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key notes from our call:
  • Primary workload: real-time summarization of financial reports (90% of calls under 512 tokens).
  • Current pain: unpredictable token costs and occasional tail latency spikes during peak batch runs.
  • Stakeholders to include for next meeting: Security (data residency & audit logs), Procurement (SOW/pricing), and Platform/SE for a technical deep dive.

Next steps / ask:
1) Plan a 60–75 minute technical deep dive/demo with our solutions engineer to walk through runtime configs, batching, and KV caching.
2) Can you loop in your security and procurement contacts so we can cover SOC 2 / data handling questions?
3) Proposed times (PST): Wed 12/02 10:00–11:15am or Thu 12/03 1:00–2:15pm. If neither works, share a few slots and we’ll align.

Attaching a short MAAP doc with the initial security questions to make the call efficient.

Best,
Marissa
